question: What limits of pervasion are taught in this scripture?
premises: Pervasion or extent is the subject
One limit is up to māyā
Another limit is up to prakṛti
inference: In this scripture the pervasion is taught as extending up to māyā or up to prakṛti
uncertainties: The term phelā is uncommon and its precise technical sense is uncertain
plain_english: In this scripture, the pervasion is said to extend up to māyā or up to prakṛti.
